question: ¿Qué tres empresas de la industria, como sponsor principal, acumulan más ensayos terminados o retirados (detenidos) de cáncer de pulmón?

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN aact.sponsors sp ON sp.nct_id = s.nct_id AND sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead' AND sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY'
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_condition tc
    JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
    JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id AND md.label = 'Lung Neoplasms'
    WHERE tc.nct_id = s.nct_id)
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 3
